claims: The World Health Organization (WHO) is a specialized United Nations agency.
The World Health Organization (WHO) is responsible for international public health.
The World Health Organization (WHO) is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
WHO coordinates responses to health emergencies.
WHO leads global efforts on health emergencies such as COVID-19, Zika, and Ebola.
WHO's Triple Billion Targets aim to have 1 billion more people benefiting from universal health coverage.
WHO's Triple Billion Targets aim to have 1 billion more people better protected from health emergencies.
WHO's Triple Billion Targets aim to have 1 billion more people enjoying better health and well-being.
WHO sets health norms and standards.
WHO provides technical support to countries.
WHO's mission is to promote health, keep the world safe, and serve the vulnerable.
WHO's mission includes a goal of achieving the highest possible level of health for all people.
